entries.en: well curb; the stone ring or parapet around a well mouth
brocade
entries.notes: 释义从 H「錦」与 L「Brocad(o)」；M 栏第二读 gīm sū 未详，疑为「金丝／锦丝」，未采入。

entries.zh: 锦绣；锦与绣（华美丝织与刺绣）
entries.en: brocade and embroidery; figured silk
entries.notes: M、R 两栏同作 quīm fū，与第 6 条「繡=fū」一致，可互证。

entries.zh: 花锦缎；织有花纹的锦缎
entries.en: figured brocade; brocade with woven patterns
entries.notes: M 栏中「de labores」系西语词头回写，非闽南语读，释义仍以 H「錦緞」为准。

entries.en: flowered brocade; richly figured brocade
entries.notes: 词头「mui」当为「muy」；M 栏末「iog」处标 T99 污损难辨，未采入释义。

entries.en: embroidery; embroidered work
entries.notes: 词头截作「brocad -」，即 brocado；H 栏单作「繡」，与第 3 条同读 fū。

entries.zh: 船蛆（蛀船虫，蛀食船木的海生钻孔贝类）；俗称「狗食柴」
entries.en: shipworm (Teredo navalis), the wood-boring marine borer that eats ship timbers
entries.notes: L 栏明言「come la madera de los navíos」；M 第二读 caú chià chā̃ 为俗名（狗食柴），释义取 L 描述。

entries.zh: 船蛆蛀木；蛀船虫食木材
entries.en: the shipworm bores into and eats wood
buckler; small round shield
entries.notes: H、R 两栏均空，词头自带[疑]标记，仅据 L「Broquel」与 M「sīn pāy」（疑为「盾牌／籐牌」）推定。

entries.en: to sprout; to shoot forth, emerging from somewhere
entries.notes: H「跟」与「发芽」义不合，疑为形近误录；释义据 L 西语描述定。

entries.en: it has sprouted already; it has come out
entries.notes: H 栏末字标[残]；M、R 两栏读法一致，义从 L「brotó ya, salió」。

entries.zh: （芽）顶破土面而出，在土中穿出孔洞
entries.en: to sprout up through the soil, piercing a hole in the ground
entries.notes: L「serpa」疑为「se abre」之讹；H「跟」同第 10 条，义据 L 文义定。

entries.en: to put forth new shoots (of a tree); to grow (hair)
entries.notes: L「reñebres」即 renuevos（新芽）；M「gī lāy」当为「枝來」，即发枝。

entries.en: to come down with a fever; for a fever to break out
to give out light; to shine forth
entries.notes: 「發明」此处取「发出光亮」古义，非现代「发明」义，与 L「salir la luz」相合。

entries.en: (of a tree) to bud; to put forth shoots
entries.notes: H「樣」用于发芽义罕见，疑为「穎／芽」之借字；M 末「pg pīt」为缩写，未能定读。

entries.zh: 发出来；生出（不拘何种方式）
entries.en: to come forth; to sprout in any manner
entries.notes: R 末字作 tāy，与 M「lāy（來）」不合，H 栏从「來」定。

entries.zh: 树木发芽（原件作「伯／柏」，与词头义不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: (of a tree) to sprout — Chinese column reads 伯/柏 and does not match; uncertain
entries.notes: H「伯／柏」与「Brotar el arbol」义不合，M「Pīg pīt」、R「pē」亦难与「发芽」对应，疑原稿串行或误录。

entries.en: (of water) to gush forth; to well up with force
entries.notes: M 第二读 chūĩ 即「水」，与「湧」合为「湧水」。

entries.en: (of the land) to bring forth; to yield produce
entries.notes: M 第二读 sē̃ 疑为「生」，与「產」并列为同义读；释义从 H「產」。
